title: Coherent contracted powers of a Zariski torsor
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on the small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and $T$ a $G$-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor]. A coherent contracted-power system consists of $G$-torsors $P_n$ for $n\in\mathbf Z$, with $P_0=G$ (translation), $P_1=T$, and $P_{-1}$ the underlying sheaf of $T$ with action $g\cdot s=(-g)\cdot_Ts$, together with binary contracted product presentations [def-sc-binary-contracted-product-presentation] $q_{m,n}:P_m\times P_n\to P_{m+n}$. These presentations identify $P_{m+n}$ canonically with $P_m\wedge P_n$; in particular they recursively give the positive and negative iterated contracted powers of $T$ and its inverse. Require $q_{0,n}(g,t)=g\cdot t$, $q_{n,0}(t,g)=g\cdot t$, associativity $q_{l+m,n}(q_{l,m}(x,y),z)=q_{l,m+n}(x,q_{m,n}(y,z))$, commutativity $q_{n,m}(y,x)=q_{m,n}(x,y)$, and the cancellation formula $q_{1,-1}(t,s)\cdot_Ts=t$. Equal degree indices are identified by the indicated integer equalities.
